name: ASTRA-HyRAX
source: AUSSP mission page https://space.auburn.edu/astra/; Gunter's Space Page https://space.skyrocket.de/doc_sdat/astra-hyrax.htm (STP-S29A, Minotaur-4, 2026-04-07).
notes: Auburn Satellite Testbed for Retrodirective Array, Hybrid Retrodirective Array in X-band. 3U EnduroSat bus, US Army SMDC funded, manifested on STP-S29A. X-band payload is not an amateur allocation. Specific FCC filing dates are not in public records.

launchDate.note: STP-S29A / Minotaur-4 from Vandenberg SLC-8 on 2026-04-07 per Gunter's Space Page catalog entry for ASTRA-HyRAX.

deliveryDate.note: Six weeks before the documented launch, typical rideshare delivery. Not in public records.

lvDeterminationDate.note: Six months before estimated delivery. Not in public records.

integrationDate.note: Six weeks before estimated delivery. Not in public records.

frequencyMHz.note: Payload is X-band (IEEE 8-12 GHz). 8500 MHz is a placeholder inside X-band; the flight frequency is not in the public AUSSP page. Not an amateur allocation, so pathway is experimental.

apogeeKm.note: Gunter lists orbit blank. 500 km is a typical LEO rideshare altitude, labeled estimate, not a catalog value.

perigeeKm.note: Circular estimate. Same basis as apogeeKm.

ballisticCoefficient.note: 3U EnduroSat bus. Bc about 180 kg/m^2, same 3U assumption as GT-1.

imagingEarth.note: AUSSP page: hybrid retrodirective array characterizes signal direction from targets of opportunity. Not an Earth-imaging mission.

pathway.note: X-band payload is outside Part 97 amateur allocations. Part 5 experimental is the remaining non-Part-25 path. Confirm against the actual FCC grant if recovered.
